segments.text: Earlier in the series, when we introduced a variety of glassware in the chemistry laboratory,
segments.zh: 在本系列前面介绍化学实验室中的各种玻璃仪器时，

segments.text: we talked a little bit about the purposes intended for each, including volume measurement.
segments.zh: 我们稍微讲了一下每种仪器的用途，其中包括量取体积。

segments.text: Beakers and flasks have volume markings on them like these.
segments.zh: 烧杯和烧瓶上有像这样的体积刻度。

segments.text: We may be tempted to think that this is suitable for measuring 150 milliliters of fluid, for
segments.zh: 我们可能会以为这适合用来量取 150 毫升液体，

segments.text: example, but any such measurements will be rather inaccurate because these are approximate
segments.zh: 比如说，但这样的量取都会相当不准确，因为这些只是近似

segments.text: values.
segments.zh: 数值。

segments.text: The width of the vessel means that a small error contributes to a large difference in volume
segments.zh: 容器的宽度意味着一个小小的误差，就会造成读出的体积

segments.text: that will be read.
segments.zh: 相差很大。

segments.text: Graduated cylinders are much better for measuring volume because the cylinders are narrower,
segments.zh: 量筒更适合量取体积，因为量筒更窄，

segments.text: and they have more volume markings to minimize errors.
segments.zh: 而且有更多的体积刻度，可以把误差降到最低。

segments.text: However, they also have their limits when it comes to small volumes.
segments.zh: 不过，在量取小体积时，量筒也有其局限性。

segments.text: Specific flasks are another good option for measuring volume because this line here will
segments.zh: 容量瓶是量取体积的另一个好选择，因为这里的这条线

segments.text: indicate that, in this instance, you have precisely 250 milliliters, and it's hard
segments.zh: 表示，在这个例子中，你正好有 250 毫升，而且很难

segments.text: to generate a lot of error.
segments.zh: 产生很大的误差。

segments.text: But this limits us to just one specific volume.
segments.zh: 但这把我们限制在了某一个特定的体积上。

segments.text: Therefore, we need a more accurate way to measure volumes.
segments.zh: 因此，我们需要一种更准确的量取体积的方法。

segments.text: Pipettes are perfect for this.
segments.zh: 移液管非常适合做这件事。

segments.text: We use them to accurately measure a wide range of volumes, from just a few microliters
segments.zh: 我们用它们准确量取各种体积，从仅仅几微升

segments.text: up to tens of milliliters.
segments.zh: 一直到几十毫升。

segments.text: Pipettes come in different shapes and sizes, but they can be defined as lab instruments
segments.zh: 移液管有各种形状和规格，但可以把它们定义为一类实验仪器，

segments.text: which can measure small volumes of liquid in an accurate and efficient manner.
segments.zh: 能够准确、高效地量取少量液体。

segments.text: They are usually comprised of a tube and an aspirator at the top.
segments.zh: 它们通常由一根管子和顶部的吸液装置组成。

segments.text: You can then stick it in the liquid, aspirate it up to the volume you want, and then transfer
segments.zh: 你可以把它插进液体里，吸到你想要的体积，然后

segments.text: that volume to another container by releasing the aspirator.
segments.zh: 松开吸液装置，把这些液体转移到另一个容器中。

segments.text: But these can sometimes be very different from one another.
segments.zh: 但这些移液管有时彼此差别很大。

segments.text: For example, in chemistry labs we like to use glass pipettes like these.
segments.zh: 例如，在化学实验室里，我们喜欢用像这样的玻璃移液管。

segments.text: They can transfer volumes from 1 milliliter up to tens of milliliters.
segments.zh: 它们可以转移 1 毫升到几十毫升的体积。

segments.text: To use these we push the top end into a bulb like this.
segments.zh: 使用时，我们把上端插进像这样的洗耳球里。

segments.text: We can then press the bulb to let the air out, and keep it pressed.
segments.zh: 然后我们可以按压洗耳球把空气排出，并保持按住。

segments.text: When you then place this in a liquid, releasing the bulb slowly will bring the liquid into
segments.zh: 接着把它放进液体中，慢慢松开洗耳球，液体就会被吸入

segments.text: the pipette, and you can stop when the liquid reaches your desired volume.
segments.zh: 移液管，等液体到达你想要的体积时就可以停下。

segments.text: You can then transfer this to the desired container and push the bulb to let your measured
segments.zh: 然后你可以把它转移到目标容器中，按压洗耳球，让量好的

segments.text: liquid out.
segments.zh: 液体流出来。

segments.text: To make this more accurate, we use pumps like these so that you can push slowly.
segments.zh: 为了更加准确，我们会使用像这样的移液泵，这样你就可以慢慢推压。

segments.text: An interesting innovation is these automatic pipettes, which will aspirate and release
segments.zh: 一个有趣的创新是这种电动移液器，按一下按钮就能吸取和释放

segments.text: your liquid with a push of a button.
segments.zh: 液体。

segments.text: These are great for when you're doing a lot of repetitive measurements in one experiment
segments.zh: 当你在一个实验中要做大量重复的量取时，这种移液器非常好用，

segments.text: since it can get tiring.
segments.zh: 因为手动操作会很累。

segments.text: When it comes to smaller volumes, we use different types of pipettes.
segments.zh: 对于更小的体积，我们会使用不同类型的移液管。

segments.text: The most common pipettes in a chem lab are these disposable pasture pipettes, which are
segments.zh: 化学实验室里最常见的是这种一次性巴斯德滴管，它们

segments.text: great for transferring small volumes.
segments.zh: 非常适合转移少量液体。

segments.text: They can have markings on them so that you know how much you're transferring.
segments.zh: 它们上面可以有刻度，这样你就知道自己转移了多少。

segments.text: We also have glass versions of these since some liquids don't work with plastic.
segments.zh: 我们也有玻璃材质的，因为有些液体不能用塑料。

segments.text: We call these transfer pipettes, and they are not disposable, so be sure to clean them
segments.zh: 我们把这些叫做转移滴管，它们不是一次性的，所以用完后一定要

segments.text: and store them appropriately when finished working with them.
segments.zh: 清洗干净并妥善存放。

segments.text: As you can see, some of these don't have markings, so we use them to transfer fluid
segments.zh: 如你所见，其中有些没有刻度，所以我们用它们把液体转移到

segments.text: into something that has markings, or to add solutions drop-wise, meaning slowly, one drop
segments.zh: 有刻度的容器中，或者逐滴加入溶液，也就是慢慢地、一次

segments.text: at a time.
segments.zh: 一滴地加。

segments.text: A rule of thumb in the lab is that 20 drops from this will give you about 1 milliliter.
segments.zh: 实验室里的一条经验法则是，用这种滴管滴 20 滴大约是 1 毫升。

segments.text: But as you can imagine, this is not precisely accurate.
segments.zh: 但你可以想象，这并不十分准确。

segments.text: That's why for smaller scale experiments, especially in analytical chemistry or biochemistry,
segments.zh: 这就是为什么在较小规模的实验中，特别是在分析化学或生物化学中，

segments.text: we use these micropipettes.
segments.zh: 我们会使用这些微量移液器。

segments.text: These can be very accurate all the way down to 1 microliter, and the measurements are repeatable,
segments.zh: 它们一直到 1 微升都可以非常准确，而且测量结果可重复，

segments.text: but they have to be calibrated regularly to stay accurate.
segments.zh: 但必须定期校准才能保持准确。

segments.text: These pipettes use the same principle of aspirating the volume and dispensing it.
segments.zh: 这些移液器同样利用吸取体积再分配出去的原理。

segments.text: However with these ones, you set up the volume you want beforehand and attach a special disposable
segments.zh: 不过对于这种移液器，你要事先设定好想要的体积，并装上专用的一次性

segments.text: pipette tip.
segments.zh: 移液器吸头。

segments.text: When ready to take up volume, you push the piston down and put your tip in the solution.
segments.zh: 准备吸液时，你把活塞按下去，再把吸头放进溶液中。

segments.text: When you release the piston, the pipette will only take in the set volume, so there
segments.zh: 松开活塞时，移液器只会吸入设定的体积，所以

segments.text: is no need to try to stop at a certain volume.
segments.zh: 不需要设法停在某个体积上。

segments.text: To illustrate how to get volume measurements, let's make a standard solution together,
segments.zh: 为了说明如何量取体积，我们一起来配制一份标准溶液，

segments.text: which we will use in an experiment later in the series.
segments.zh: 我们会在本系列后面的一个实验中用到它。

segments.text: A standard solution is a solution containing a precisely known concentration of a chemical.
segments.zh: 标准溶液是一种所含化学物质浓度被精确知道的溶液。

segments.text: These are incredibly important in chemistry, because these known concentrations can be
segments.zh: 标准溶液在化学中极其重要，因为这些已知浓度可以

segments.text: used to measure concentrations of unknown substances.
segments.zh: 用来测定未知物质的浓度。

segments.text: Today we will make a standard solution for potassium hydrogen phthalate, or KHP.
segments.zh: 今天我们要配制邻苯二甲酸氢钾，也就是 KHP 的标准溶液。

segments.text: This is a common acid used in chemistry labs for acid-based titrations.
segments.zh: 这是化学实验室里酸碱滴定常用的一种酸。

segments.text: Let's make a 0.1 molar aqueous solution of KHP.
segments.zh: 我们来配制 0.1 摩尔每升的 KHP 水溶液。

segments.text: To do that, let's weigh 5 grams of the powder and add it to a 500 milliliter beaker.
segments.zh: 为此，我们称取 5 克粉末，加入一个 500 毫升的烧杯中。

segments.text: Add a stir bar and about 200 milliliters of water to dissolve the powder.
segments.zh: 加入一个搅拌子和大约 200 毫升水，使粉末溶解。

segments.text: Now looking at the molar mass, we can do some calculations to see that exactly 250 milliliters
segments.zh: 根据摩尔质量，我们可以算一下，需要向 5 克 KHP 中加入正好 250 毫升

segments.text: of water needs to be added to 5 grams of KHP to make the solution 0.1 molar.
segments.zh: 水，才能使溶液浓度为 0.1 摩尔每升。

segments.text: So after we dissolve this in the beaker, we will want to transfer it to a 250 milliliter
segments.zh: 所以在烧杯中溶解之后，我们要把它转移到一个 250 毫升的

segments.text: volumetric flask.
segments.zh: 容量瓶中。

segments.text: We can transfer the solution to the volumetric flask using a glass funnel, pouring slowly
segments.zh: 我们可以用玻璃漏斗把溶液转移到容量瓶中，要慢慢地、

segments.text: and carefully.
segments.zh: 小心地倒。

segments.text: Let's then use a water bottle to clean the beaker so that all of our KHP has been
segments.zh: 然后用洗瓶冲洗烧杯，确保所有 KHP 都已

segments.text: transferred to the flask.
segments.zh: 转移到容量瓶中。

segments.text: To add the rest of the water, we can use a water bottle, but once we start approaching
segments.zh: 剩下的水可以用洗瓶加入，但一旦开始接近

segments.text: the final volume, we will want to use a transfer pipette to add the last few milliliters.
segments.zh: 最终体积，我们就要用转移滴管加入最后几毫升。

segments.text: Add water until the bottom of the meniscus touches the 250 milliliter line.
segments.zh: 加水直到弯月面的底部与 250 毫升刻度线相切。

segments.text: You have now made a 0.1 molar standard of KHP.
segments.zh: 现在你就配好了 0.1 摩尔每升的 KHP 标准溶液。

segments.text: We will frequently be making standard solutions of around this volume in the chemistry lab.
segments.zh: 在化学实验室里，我们会经常配制大约这个体积的标准溶液。

segments.text: Smaller standards can be made by using micropipettes.
segments.zh: 更小量的标准溶液可以用微量移液器来配制。

segments.text: With this technique understood, let's move forward and see how it can be applied in
segments.zh: 理解了这项技术后，我们继续往下，看看它如何应用在

segments.text: certain experiments.
segments.zh: 某些实验中。
